title: Ordinary People, Extraordinary Stories Creative Clinic
intro: We’re running a free two day Creative Clinic for 16 to 19 year olds

image.alt: two day free youth Creative Clinic

sections.text: Calling 16 to 19 year old Tower Hamlets residents, come along to the London Metropolitan Archives and Toynbee Hall’s free two day Creative Clinic on Friday 15th and Saturday 16th March.
Two days of tapping into extraordinary untold stories. Create new tales in the form of scripts, prose, poetry, lyrics, you choose! We are offering this unique two day skills sharing programme:

items: Showcase opportunity for Word on the Street Festival 2019

sections.text: To find out more and book your place, contact lisa.wilkinson@toynbeehall.org.uk or call 020 7392 2986
